_README: Text for the four pack covers. Page counts and mark totals below were counted from the pack PDFs on 16 August 2026, not copied from the old covers, which had four wrong page counts and one wrong mark total between them. If a pack is re-exported, recount and regenerate rather than editing the picture.

_verified.week1 samples: page counts recounted 16 Aug 2026 from the corrected samples: A-Level Business 6 (was 5), Economics 5, GCSE Business 8, IGCSE 0455 8 (was 7). The two that changed grew because the corrections added content.

_dropped: The diagram counts are gone from the Economics and IGCSE covers. The Economics cover said 20 while the pack's own free sample says 18, and the IGCSE cover said eleven while its sample says thirteen. Neither could be settled by counting the PDF, because the diagrams are vector line art that no reliable detector separates from table rules. Put a number back only once somebody has paged through and counted.
